We splice, not cover

Soft wood cut out to sound stock, new wood spliced in, primed on all six sides.

When the screwdriver sinks past a quarter inch, the wood is gone. We cut back to solid stock, scarf in a new piece of white oak, and prime every face so moisture cannot get behind the patch.

Sample pricing: $275–$650 per sill Sample pricing

New wood that disappears into the old

Bring a six-inch offcut or a photo with a ruler. We mill the profile so the new piece matches what was there.
